test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which one of the following is the Directive Principle of State Policy?

options.text: To cherish and follow the ideals of the national struggle
To strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity
Upholding the constitution and its ideals
Maintaining social order for the promotion of public welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __ **Maintaining social order for the promotion of public welfare**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maintaining social order for the promotion of public welfare**
 
• This option is closely related to the Directive Principles of State Policy, which aim to guide the state in promoting social justice and welfare through various policies, including maintaining social order.
 
• The** DPSP is a fundamental part of governance in India, and it's the state's duty to apply these principles when making laws.**
 
• The DPSP aims to make India a welfare state by promoting the welfare of the people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The DPSP is contained in Articles 36–51 of Part IV of the Indian Constitution. The DPSP was borrowed from the Irish Constitution of 1937, which in turn borrowed it from the Spanish Constitution. The DPSP is non-justiciable, meaning it'**s not enforceable in a court of law.
